subject: Santa at CityCentre, a free Frozen night and Nutcracker music
preheader: Plus: a quiet week to rest, then a busy first weekend of December.
intro: No school this week (Nov 23–27), so enjoy the slow days. Saturday, Nov 28 brings Santa and two reindeer to CityCentre from 12 to 4 for free photos, and the next week has Nutcracker music for toddlers and pinecone gnomes at the Spring Branch Memorial library.

Mark Friday, Dec 4: Memorial Park's free Neighborhood Nights kicks off the holiday lights with a Frozen movie at 6 pm. Bring a blanket. The Arboretum's wreath workshop is Saturday, Dec 5, and tickets are needed.

items.title: Greenside, a family-friendly spot with a kids' play structure, is coming to Memorial City
items.description: A new family-friendly hangout built around a one-acre lawn is coming to 1085 Gessner, with a children's play area in the plans. Michelin-recognized Pizzana is among the restaurants opening there this fall.
paragraphs: A new family-friendly hangout built around a one-acre lawn is coming to 1085 Gessner, with a children's play area in the plans. Michelin-recognized Pizzana is among the restaurants opening there this fall.

image.alt: Rendering of Greenside's garden: kids playing in and around two wooden A-frame playhouses among flowering trees, while parents sit on long benches nearby.
image.credit: Rendering courtesy of MetroNational & Radom Capital / Michael Hsu Office of Architecture

image.alt: Illustration: An outdoor plaza at dusk with a giant decorated Christmas tree and twinkle lights, kids in winter hats meeting a friendly Santa and a reindeer in a small pen, families holding hot cocoa

items.title: Holiday in the Plaza
items.description: Meet Santa and two of his reindeer, with free professional photos, plus holiday singing and dancing. A donation for the SPCA is welcome. Santa leaves at 4 pm, so arrive on time; weather permitting.

image.alt: Illustration: Toddlers and preschoolers dancing and waving scarves to classical music in a library meeting room, a music leader smiling and leading, parents clapping along

items.title: Classical Sing Move Play: Music of the Nutcracker
items.description: A music and movement class for ages 2 to 5 where kids sing, move and play to Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker music, in the library meeting room. The page doesn't mention registration; call the branch to confirm.

image.alt: Illustration: White children (about 4 to 7 years old) and a white mom around a library craft table, gluing felt hats and fluffy beards onto pinecones to make tiny gnomes, pom-poms and glue sticks scattered about

items.title: Pinecone Gnomes craft
items.description: After-school craft for ages 4 to 8 (preschool through 2nd grade): each child makes a little gnome from a pinecone. The page doesn't mention registration.

image.alt: Illustration: Families on picnic blankets on a park lawn at dusk watching an outdoor movie on a big screen, kids in winter coats holding cups of cocoa, a small toy train and twinkling holiday lights nearby, Santa waving

items.title: Neighborhood Nights: Holiday Edition
items.where: Memorial Park, Clay Family Eastern Glades, 6502 Memorial Dr
items.description: A free holiday evening on the lawn: Frozen movie at 6 pm, photos with Santa, Anna and Elsa, letters to Santa, a train ride, cocoa and food trucks. Bring a blanket; no strollers or bikes. Listing end time varies (8 or 9 pm).

image.alt: Illustration: Kids (ages 6–10) and parents at long tables in a nature center making wreaths and ornaments from grapevine, pinecones and red berries, greenery everywhere, warm light

items.title: Homemade Holidays wreath and ornament workshop
items.description: Make a wreath, ornaments and handmade gifts from grapevine, branches, berries and pinecones with hands-on help. Ages 5 and up with an adult; wear clothes that can get messy.

items.title: Mia's Table – Memorial City
items.when: Memorial City · $$ · Kids' menu, Play area
items.description: A family-friendly American kitchen made with parents in mind: kids' meals, grown-up food you'll actually want, and a play area local parents rave about.

items.title: Tia Maria's
items.when: Oak Forest · $ · Free treat, Kids' menu
items.description: Tex-Mex with a free self-serve soft-serve machine by the front door. Kids will remember it.

items.title: Recess
items.when: Montrose / Heights · $$ · Indoor play, Kids' menu
items.description: A family restaurant built around two climate-controlled indoor playgrounds: the Garden for ages 1–3 (with parents) and the supervised Canopy for ages 4–11. The restaurant is upstairs.

image.alt: Illustration: A warm, realistic, candid photo at a Houston neighborhood playground on a cool, sunny December morning, landscape

items.title: Two weeks of winter break doesn't need a schedule. It needs two anchors.
items.description: SBISD is off Dec 21 to Jan 4. You don't need a color-coded plan to keep little ones sane, just steady sleep, a simple day shape and an easy way back.

image.alt: Illustration: A warm, realistic, candid photo in a bright Houston family kitchen on a December afternoon, landscape

items.title: Grandma wants to kiss the baby. In RSV season, you're allowed to say no.
items.description: A newborn, a houseful of relatives and peak RSV and flu season. What pediatric guidance says about visitors, kisses and vaccines, plus kind scripts for saying no.

items.title: SBISD Thanksgiving break
items.description: No school all week. Plan library visits and park days early, since popular spots fill up.

items.title: SBISD winter break
items.description: Two weeks off school. We'll round up winter break camps and indoor ideas in December.
